rules: A social event may affect different participants differently.
No single generic numeric friendship delta is required.
Repeated contact may increase familiarity without increasing friendship.
Successful professional collaboration may increase professional respect without increasing personal affinity.
A favor does not guarantee future compliance.
An apology may be accepted without fully restoring trust.
Consensual intimacy does not automatically create an established relationship.
Romantic rejection does not automatically create hostility.
Professional rank does not override personal consent.
AI may express the consequence but authoritative relationship state changes must be validated from the event and rules.
Ordinary non-romantic social events do not use romantic compatibility as an eligibility filter.
Romantic/sexual event families must satisfy the project relationship canon before any such transition is eligible.
Player romantic interest, consent, acceptance and commitment are explicit player actions and are never inferred from state.
NPC romantic expression toward the player requires an authoritative directional romantic-interest state with causal provenance.
Date invitation, date acceptance, date completion and relationship commitment are distinct events.
Romantic rejection alone cannot authoritatively create hostility or resentment.
NPC-to-NPC Academy social events may evolve directional relationship dimensions independently.
Autonomous friendship/romance transitions require their specific evidence gates rather than generic positive-contact accumulation alone.
